name: Heating Load Forecasting Benchmark (SHAP-based)
description: A large-scale benchmark dataset and evaluation suite for heating load forecasting that incorporates SHAP-based static features to assess transfer learning and explainable AI approaches.
reputation: New academic benchmark (2026) aimed at energy forecasting and explainability research; not yet broadly adopted outside the originating study.
notes: Non-LLM time-series benchmark emphasizing SHAP-based static features for transfer learning and explainability. Potential issues include temporal leakage if train/val/test splits are not strictly time-contiguous and sensitivity to seasonality and covariate shift across buildings/regions.
